summary: Frontend-only testing of new Dashboard page + persistent Sidebar for Valuevade. Tested protected route, empty state for a test user with no enrollment, sidebar (desktop + mobile), theme toggle, collapse toggle, sign-out, navigation, data-testids, and progress.js exports. Nearly everything works as specified. Only minor issue found: post-login redirect lands on /courses instead of /dashboard (app-level flow, not sidebar/dashboard bug) and mobile drawer overlay close click only works if user clicks outside the 280px drawer area (expected CSS behavior).

integration_issues.issue: After successful login, user is redirected to /courses (not /dashboard). User can manually navigate to /dashboard and empty state works correctly. If spec expected /dashboard after login for users w/o enrollment, revisit post-login redirect logic in AuthContext/Login page.

action_items: (Optional) Review post-login redirect: currently goes to /courses, spec implies /dashboard should load and show empty state with 'Browse Courses' CTA. Dashboard empty state itself works perfectly when accessed directly.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx is ~670 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider extracting ContinueLearningCard, ModuleCard, StatCard, DashboardSkeleton into /components/dashboard/ sub-files for maintainability.

Sidebar.jsx fetches enrollment+modules on every location.pathname change (useEffect deps include location.pathname). This triggers a Supabase round-trip on every route change. Consider caching or only refetching on explicit invalidation.
progress.js: markPhaseComplete does two sequential updates (phase flag + completion) - could be combined into one update with computed payload to halve DB round-trips.
handleSignOut calls navigate('/') but observed redirect lands on /login. If '/' is the public landing page, this is still ok; verify intended behavior.

updateStats: streak computation ignores timezones - new Date(today) vs last_active_date uses local-date string which is fine but diffDays math using raw Date subtraction can be off by 1 across DST boundaries. Use a UTC-based date diff helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All dashboard data-testids are present and verified: sidebar, nav-dashboard/my-course/profile/settings, sidebar-logo, sidebar-hamburger, sidebar-close-mobile, sidebar-theme-toggle, sidebar-signout, sidebar-collapse-toggle, sidebar-mobile-overlay, dashboard-empty, dashboard-browse-courses. The populated dashboard (dashboard-content with dashboard-welcome, dashboard-stats, stat-*, dashboard-module-timeline, dashboard-capstone, continue-learning-*) was NOT tested because test user has no enrollment (per reviewer note). To test full populated view, seed Supabase with a user_enrollment + user_modules + user_sessions for testagent2026@gmail.com. Theme localStorage key is 'vv-theme'. Sidebar collapse localStorage key is 'vv-sidebar-collapsed'.
